"""Current Q2/U4 cumulative confidence 0 versus 0.5; same EXE, weights and cache."""
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback

import practical as p


def run(name):
    out = p.H / name
    out.mkdir()
    cfg = json.loads((p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    assert cfg['env']['STRATA_MTP_CUM_MIN_P'] == '0'
    assert cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--expert-cache') + 1] == '5500'
    assert cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--suffix-draft') + 1] == '0'
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(cfg)
    candidate['env']['STRATA_MTP_CUM_MIN_P'] = '0.5'
    inputs = json.loads((p.H / 'gated-current-r1-inputs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    r = dict(complete=False, scope=__doc__, order=['baseline', 'early', 'baseline'],
             configs={'baseline': cfg, 'early': candidate},
             inputs={k: inputs[k] for k in (*p.CASES, 'Chinese')},
             gate=dict(min_throughput_change_pct=1, max_abs_baseline_drift_pct=3,
                       metrics=['decode_ms', 'request_ms'], exact_output_required=True),
             runs=[], comparison={}, correctness=False)
    save = lambda: p.b.save(out / 'results.json', r)
    p.b.save(out / 'prepared.json', r)
    (out / 'runner.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    with p.b.gpu_lock():
        try:
            rt = Path(cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--mtp') + 1])
            files = [p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json', p.R / 'tools/bench_deepinfer.py',
                     Path(__file__), Path(p.__file__), Path(cfg['exe']), p.R / 'data/expert-profile.bin',
                     *(rt / x for x in ('dense.txt', 'dense.bin', 'experts.bin'))]
            r['input_sha256'] = {str(f): p.b.sha(f) for f in files}
            save()
            reference = {}
            for i, mode in enumerate(r['order']):
                arm = dict(mode=mode, rows=[])
                r['runs'].append(arm)
                save()
                e = p.b.Engine.__new__(p.b.Engine)
                print('START', i, mode, flush=True)
                try:
                    arm_cfg = r['configs'][mode]
                    e.__init__(Path(arm_cfg['exe']), arm_cfg['args'], p.environment(arm_cfg), out / str(i))
                    arm.update(info=e.info, ready_ms=e.ready_ms)
                    assert 'expert_slots=5771 ' in e.info and 'lookup=0 ' in e.info
                    arm['initializer'] = e.gen(inputs['Chinese'], 16, keys='temperature=0')
                    for cycle in range(4):
                        for case in p.CASES:
                            row = e.gen(inputs[case], 128, keys='temperature=0')
                            row.update(case=case, cycle=cycle, retained=cycle > 0)
                            reference.setdefault(case, row)
                            row['matches'] = all(row[k] == reference[case][k] for k in p.KEYS)
                            assert row['generated'] == 128 and row['prompt_tokens'] == 2048
                            assert row['finish'] == 'length' and row['reused'] == row['resume'] == 0
                            arm['rows'].append(row)
                            save()
                            print(i, mode, cycle, case, 'MATCH' if row['matches'] else 'MISMATCH',
                                  'decode', row['decode_ms'], 'request', round(row['request_ms'], 2),
                                  'draft', row['accepted'], '/', row['offered'], flush=True)
                finally:
                    if hasattr(e, 'p'):
                        e.close()
                        arm['exit_code'] = e.p.returncode
                    save()
                assert arm['exit_code'] == 0
            r['correctness'] = all(row['matches'] for arm in r['runs'] for row in arm['rows'])
            r['comparison'] = p.compare(r)
            r['passes_gate'] = r['correctness'] and all(
                values['throughput_change_pct'] >= r['gate']['min_throughput_change_pct'] and
                abs(values['baseline_drift_pct']) <= r['gate']['max_abs_baseline_drift_pct']
                for metrics in r['comparison'].values() for k, values in metrics.items() if k in r['gate']['metrics'])
            assert all(p.b.sha(Path(f)) == h for f, h in r['input_sha256'].items())
            r['complete'] = True
            print('RESULT', json.dumps(r['comparison']), 'passes_gate', r['passes_gate'], flush=True)
        except BaseException:
            r['error'] = traceback.format_exc()
            raise
        finally:
            save()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    run(sys.argv[1])

"""Current Q2/U4 cumulative confidence 0 versus 0.5; same EXE, weights and cache."""
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback

import practical as p


def run(name):
    out = p.H / name
    out.mkdir()
    cfg = json.loads((p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    assert cfg['env']['STRATA_MTP_CUM_MIN_P'] == '0'
    assert cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--expert-cache') + 1] == '5500'
    assert cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--suffix-draft') + 1] == '0'
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(cfg)
    candidate['env']['STRATA_MTP_CUM_MIN_P'] = '0.5'
    inputs = json.loads((p.H / 'gated-current-r1-inputs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    r = dict(complete=False, scope=__doc__, order=['baseline', 'early', 'baseline'],
             configs={'baseline': cfg, 'early': candidate},
             inputs={k: inputs[k] for k in (*p.CASES, 'Chinese')},
             gate=dict(min_throughput_change_pct=1, max_abs_baseline_drift_pct=3,
                       metrics=['decode_ms', 'request_ms'], exact_output_required=True),
             runs=[], comparison={}, correctness=False)
    save = lambda: p.b.save(out / 'results.json', r)
    p.b.save(out / 'prepared.json', r)
    (out / 'runner.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    with p.b.gpu_lock():
        try:
            assert cfg == json.loads((p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            rt = Path(cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--mtp') + 1])
            files = [p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json', p.R / 'tools/bench_deepinfer.py',
                     Path(__file__), Path(p.__file__), Path(cfg['exe']), p.R / 'data/expert-profile.bin',
                     *(rt / x for x in ('dense.txt', 'dense.bin', 'experts.bin'))]
            files += [f for f in Path(cfg['env']['STRATA_ORCA_IMAGES']).rglob('*') if f.is_file()]
            r['input_sha256'] = {str(f): p.b.sha(f) for f in files}
            save()
            reference = {}
            for i, mode in enumerate(r['order']):
                arm = dict(mode=mode, rows=[])
                r['runs'].append(arm)
                save()
                e = p.b.Engine.__new__(p.b.Engine)
                print('START', i, mode, flush=True)
                try:
                    arm_cfg = r['configs'][mode]
                    e.__init__(Path(arm_cfg['exe']), arm_cfg['args'], p.environment(arm_cfg), out / str(i))
                    arm.update(info=e.info, ready_ms=e.ready_ms)
                    assert 'expert_slots=5771 ' in e.info and 'lookup=0 ' in e.info
                    arm['initializer'] = e.gen(inputs['Chinese'], 16, keys='temperature=0')
                    for cycle in range(4):
                        for case in p.CASES:
                            row = e.gen(inputs[case], 128, keys='temperature=0')
                            row.update(case=case, cycle=cycle, retained=cycle > 0)
                            reference.setdefault(case, row)
                            row['matches'] = all(row[k] == reference[case][k] for k in p.KEYS)
                            assert row['generated'] == 128 and row['prompt_tokens'] == 2048
                            assert row['finish'] == 'length' and row['reused'] == row['resume'] == 0
                            arm['rows'].append(row)
                            save()
                            print(i, mode, cycle, case, 'MATCH' if row['matches'] else 'MISMATCH',
                                  'decode', row['decode_ms'], 'request', round(row['request_ms'], 2),
                                  'draft', row['accepted'], '/', row['offered'], flush=True)
                finally:
                    if hasattr(e, 'p'):
                        e.close()
                        arm['exit_code'] = e.p.returncode
                    save()
                assert arm['exit_code'] == 0
            r['correctness'] = all(row['matches'] for arm in r['runs'] for row in arm['rows'])
            r['comparison'] = p.compare(r)
            r['passes_gate'] = r['correctness'] and all(
                values['throughput_change_pct'] >= r['gate']['min_throughput_change_pct'] and
                abs(values['baseline_drift_pct']) <= r['gate']['max_abs_baseline_drift_pct']
                for metrics in r['comparison'].values() for k, values in metrics.items() if k in r['gate']['metrics'])
            assert all(p.b.sha(Path(f)) == h for f, h in r['input_sha256'].items())
            r['complete'] = True
            print('RESULT', json.dumps(r['comparison']), 'passes_gate', r['passes_gate'], flush=True)
        except BaseException:
            r['error'] = traceback.format_exc()
            raise
        finally:
            save()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    run(sys.argv[1])

"""Current Q2/U4 original versus activation-calibrated Q2 experts; same EXE, format and cache."""
import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import traceback

import practical as p


def run(name, early=False):
    out = p.H / name
    out.mkdir()
    cfg = json.loads((p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    assert cfg['env']['STRATA_MTP_CUM_MIN_P'] == '0'
    assert cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--expert-cache') + 1] == '5500'
    assert cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--suffix-draft') + 1] == '0'
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(cfg)
    mode = 'combined' if early else 'calibrated'
    if early:
        candidate['env']['STRATA_MTP_CUM_MIN_P'] = '0.5'
    runtime = p.H / 'activation-calibration-r2/rt-q2-calibrated'
    candidate['args'][candidate['args'].index('--mtp') + 1] = str(runtime)
    inputs = json.loads((p.H / 'gated-current-r1-inputs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    r = dict(complete=False, scope=__doc__, order=['baseline', mode, 'baseline'],
             configs={'baseline': cfg, mode: candidate},
             inputs={k: inputs[k] for k in (*p.CASES, 'Chinese')},
             gate=dict(min_throughput_change_pct=1, max_abs_baseline_drift_pct=3,
                       metrics=['decode_ms', 'request_ms'], exact_output_required=True),
             runs=[], comparison={}, correctness=False)
    save = lambda: p.b.save(out / 'results.json', r)
    p.b.save(out / 'prepared.json', r)
    (out / 'runner.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    with p.b.gpu_lock():
        try:
            assert cfg == json.loads((p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            rt = Path(cfg['args'][cfg['args'].index('--mtp') + 1])
            files = [p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json', p.R / 'tools/bench_deepinfer.py',
                     Path(__file__), Path(p.__file__), Path(cfg['exe']), p.R / 'data/expert-profile.bin',
                     *(rt / x for x in ('dense.txt', 'dense.bin', 'experts.bin'))]
            files += [runtime / x for x in ('dense.txt', 'dense.bin', 'experts.bin')]
            files += [f for f in Path(cfg['env']['STRATA_ORCA_IMAGES']).rglob('*') if f.is_file()]
            r['weight_manifest'] = json.loads((runtime.parent / 'weights.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            assert r['weight_manifest']['complete']
            counts = json.loads((runtime.parent / 'imatrix.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))['counts']
            unchanged = 0
            with (rt / 'experts.bin').open('rb') as original, (runtime / 'experts.bin').open('rb') as converted:
                for expert, count in enumerate(counts):
                    if count < 8:
                        for file in (original, converted):
                            file.seek(expert * (707788800 // 512))
                        assert original.read(707788800 // 512) == converted.read(707788800 // 512), expert
                        unchanged += 1
            r['fallback_experts_unchanged'] = unchanged
            r['input_sha256'] = {str(f): p.b.sha(f) for f in files}
            assert r['input_sha256'][str(runtime / 'experts.bin')] == r['weight_manifest']['sha256']
            save()
            reference = {}
            for i, mode in enumerate(r['order']):
                arm = dict(mode=mode, rows=[])
                r['runs'].append(arm)
                save()
                e = p.b.Engine.__new__(p.b.Engine)
                print('START', i, mode, flush=True)
                try:
                    arm_cfg = r['configs'][mode]
                    e.__init__(Path(arm_cfg['exe']), arm_cfg['args'], p.environment(arm_cfg), out / str(i))
                    arm.update(info=e.info, ready_ms=e.ready_ms)
                    assert 'expert_slots=5771 ' in e.info and 'lookup=0 ' in e.info
                    arm['initializer'] = e.gen(inputs['Chinese'], 16, keys='temperature=0')
                    for cycle in range(4):
                        for case in p.CASES:
                            row = e.gen(inputs[case], 128, keys='temperature=0')
                            row.update(case=case, cycle=cycle, retained=cycle > 0)
                            reference.setdefault(case, row)
                            row['matches'] = all(row[k] == reference[case][k] for k in p.KEYS)
                            assert row['generated'] == 128 and row['prompt_tokens'] == 2048
                            assert row['finish'] == 'length' and row['reused'] == row['resume'] == 0
                            arm['rows'].append(row)
                            save()
                            print(i, mode, cycle, case, 'MATCH' if row['matches'] else 'MISMATCH',
                                  'decode', row['decode_ms'], 'request', round(row['request_ms'], 2),
                                  'draft', row['accepted'], '/', row['offered'], flush=True)
                finally:
                    if hasattr(e, 'p'):
                        e.close()
                        arm['exit_code'] = e.p.returncode
                    save()
                assert arm['exit_code'] == 0
            r['correctness'] = all(row['matches'] for arm in r['runs'] for row in arm['rows'])
            r['comparison'] = p.compare(r)
            r['passes_gate'] = r['correctness'] and all(
                values['throughput_change_pct'] >= r['gate']['min_throughput_change_pct'] and
                abs(values['baseline_drift_pct']) <= r['gate']['max_abs_baseline_drift_pct']
                for metrics in r['comparison'].values() for k, values in metrics.items() if k in r['gate']['metrics'])
            assert all(p.b.sha(Path(f)) == h for f, h in r['input_sha256'].items())
            r['complete'] = True
            print('RESULT', json.dumps(r['comparison']), 'passes_gate', r['passes_gate'], flush=True)
        except BaseException:
            r['error'] = traceback.format_exc()
            raise
        finally:
            save()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert len(sys.argv) in (2, 3) and (len(sys.argv) == 2 or sys.argv[2] == '--early')
    run(sys.argv[1], early=len(sys.argv) == 3)

"""Turn isolated draft activation records into a same-size Q2 expert runtime."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys

import numpy as np
import practical as p

from mtp_pack import q2_0
from mtp_rt import blob_of

HERE = p.H / 'activation-calibration-r2'


def aggregate(records, n, ff, k, ne):
    gu = np.zeros((ne, n), dtype=np.float64)
    down = np.zeros((ne, ff), dtype=np.float64)
    count = np.zeros(ne, dtype=np.int64)
    global_gu = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float64)
    for row in records:
        ids, dst = row['ids'], row['dst']
        if sorted(dst.tolist()) != list(range(k)) or len(set(ids.tolist())) != k or (ids < 0).any() or (ids >= ne).any():
            raise ValueError('invalid calibration route/permutation')
        x = row['x'].astype(np.float64)
        h = row['h'].astype(np.float64)
        if not np.isfinite(x).all() or not np.isfinite(h).all():
            raise ValueError('nonfinite calibration activations')
        experts = ids[dst]
        gu[experts] += x * x
        down[experts] += h * h
        count[experts] += 1
        global_gu += x * x
    if not len(records):
        raise ValueError('empty calibration trace')
    # ponytail: eight pseudo-observations damp a diagonal estimate; experts seen <8 times retain original bytes.
    gu += 8 * global_gu / len(records)
    down += 8 * down.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True) / np.maximum(count[:, None], 1)
    gu /= np.maximum(gu.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-30)
    down /= np.maximum(down.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-30)
    gu[count < 8] = down[count < 8] = 0
    return gu.astype(np.float32), down.astype(np.float32), count


def moments():
    result = json.loads((HERE / 'results.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    prepared = json.loads((HERE / 'prepared.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    assert result['complete'] and result['exit_code'] == 0
    assert result['source_sha256'] == prepared['source_sha256'] == p.b.sha(HERE / 'mtp.cpp')
    assert len(result['rows']) == len(prepared['inputs']) == 12
    assert all(s['prompt_tokens'] == len(ids) and 0 < s['generated'] <= 96
               for s, ids in zip(result['rows'], prepared['inputs']))
    trace = HERE / 'activation.bin'
    assert p.b.sha(trace) == result['trace_sha256']
    with trace.open('rb') as f:
        assert f.read(8) == b'MTPIMX1\0'
        n, ff, k, ne = struct.unpack('<4i', f.read(16))
    assert (n, ff, k, ne) == (2560, 640, 10, 512)
    dtype = np.dtype([('ids', '<i4', k), ('dst', '<i4', k), ('x', '<f4', n), ('h', '<f4', (k, ff))])
    excluded = result['reference_rows']
    assert len(excluded) == 2
    start = max(r['excluded_bytes'][1] for r in excluded)
    assert (start - 24) % dtype.itemsize == (trace.stat().st_size - 24) % dtype.itemsize == 0
    records = np.memmap(trace, dtype=dtype, mode='r', offset=start)
    gu, down, count = aggregate(records, n, ff, k, ne)
    with (HERE / 'imatrix.npz').open('xb') as f:
        np.savez(f, gate_up_proj=gu, down_proj=down, counts=count)
    p.b.save(HERE / 'imatrix.json', dict(records=len(records), observations=int(count.sum()),
                                        calibrated_experts=int((count >= 8).sum()),
                                        trace_sha256=result['trace_sha256'],
                                        imatrix_sha256=p.b.sha(HERE / 'imatrix.npz'),
                                        excluded_prefix_bytes=start, counts=count.tolist()))
    print('MOMENTS', len(records), 'draft evaluations;', (count >= 8).sum(), '/512 experts calibrated', flush=True)


def weights():
    rt = HERE / 'rt-q2-calibrated'
    rt.mkdir()
    source = Path('G:/GitHub/Strata-data/mtp')
    manifest = json.loads((source / 'mtp-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    rows = [next(t for t in manifest if t['name'] == 'mtp.layers.0.mlp.experts.' + key)
            for key in ('gate_up_proj', 'down_proj')]
    calibration = json.loads((HERE / 'imatrix.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    assert p.b.sha(HERE / 'imatrix.npz') == calibration['imatrix_sha256']
    with np.load(HERE / 'imatrix.npz', allow_pickle=False) as data:
        gu_importance, down_importance = data['gate_up_proj'], data['down_proj']
    with p.b.gpu_lock():
        assert all(p.b.sha(source / row['file']) == row['sha256'] for row in rows)
        raw = [np.memmap(source / row['file'], dtype='<u2', mode='r', shape=tuple(row['shape'])) for row in rows]
        with (rt / 'experts.bin.part').open('xb') as output:
            for e in range(512):
                gu, down = [(r[e].astype(np.uint32) << 16).view(np.float32) for r in raw]
                gu_bytes = q2_0(gu, gu_importance[e]).reshape(1280, -1)
                down_bytes = q2_0(down, down_importance[e]).reshape(2560, -1)
                output.write(blob_of(gu_bytes, down_bytes))
                if e % 32 == 0:
                    print('CALIBRATED Q2', e, '/512', flush=True)
        assert (rt / 'experts.bin.part').stat().st_size == 707788800
        (rt / 'experts.bin.part').rename(rt / 'experts.bin')
        args = json.loads((HERE / 'prepared.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))['config']['args']
        original_rt = Path(args[args.index('--mtp') + 1])
        for name in ('dense.bin', 'dense.txt'):

    print('PASS same-size Q2 calibrated runtime', flush=True)

    rows['dst'][:] = [1, 0]
    rows['x'][:] = np.arange(1, 65)
    rows['h'][:, 0] = np.arange(64, 0, -1)
    rows['h'][:, 1] = np.arange(1, 65)
    gu, down, count = aggregate(rows, 64, 64, 2, 3)
    assert count.tolist() == [8, 0, 8] and not gu[1].any() and not down[1].any()
    assert gu[0, -1] > gu[0, 0] and down[0, 0] > down[0, -1] and down[2, -1] > down[2, 0]
    assert np.allclose(gu[[0, 2]].mean(axis=1), 1) and np.allclose(down[[0, 2]].mean(axis=1), 1)
    for key, value in (('dst', [0, 0]), ('ids', [0, 3]), ('x', np.full(64, np.nan))):
        bad = rows.copy()
        bad[key][0] = value
        try:
            aggregate(bad, 64, 64, 2, 3)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError('malformed calibration record accepted')
    print('PASS activation moments, expert permutation, unseen fallback and invalid input rejection')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    {'moments': moments, 'weights': weights, 'selfcheck': selfcheck}[sys.argv[1]]()

"""tools/mtp_pack.py - plan v0.3 P6 prep: the MTP draft block as a Strata GGUF, from the BF16 tensors.

llama.cpp's qwen4exp converter drops the MTP head (`supports_mtp_export = False`), and the flyweight MTP GGUF is
no longer on this PC, so Strata packs its own from the 31 `mtp.*` tensors fetched by tools/mtp_fetch.py:

    python tools/mtp_pack.py --src Desktop/Strata/mtp-bf16 --experts q2_0 --out mtp-q2_0.gguf
    python tools/mtp_pack.py --src ... --experts q4_0 --out mtp-q4_0.gguf       (acceptance comparison arm)

Layout: dense tensors (attention, indexer, hyper-connections, shared expert, router, fc/norms) stay BF16 (F32 for
1-D norms), ~0.18 GB. The routed experts keep the checkpoint's fused layout - `gate_up_proj` [512, 1280, 2560] and
`down_proj` [512, 2560, 640], quantized along the last (input) axis - in one of:

    q2_0   64-element blocks, grid {-1, 0, 1, 2} x d. The scale is chosen per block to MINIMIZE squared error over
           that grid (the ggml reference sets d = max|w| and never uses the +2 level). Same format as the main
           model's experts, so Strata's CPU VNNI kernel and GPU hit kernel serve it unchanged. ~0.71 GB.
    q4_0   ggml reference rounding. ~1.42 GB.       q8_0   ggml reference. ~2.67 GB.
    q5_0   gguf-py's existing reference quantizer. ~1.73 GB (SYCL native grouped experts).

This is round-to-nearest, not GSQ: the plan picks the expert format by MEASURED draft acceptance (P0.3/P6), not
by this file's reconstruction error, which is reported per tensor only as a sanity check. No model runs here.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from _paths import add_gguf_py  # noqa: E402
add_gguf_py()
import gguf  # noqa: E402  (the pinned llama.cpp gguf-py, which knows Q2_0 = type 42)

class _Experts:
    """Index an expert out of a BF16 memmap as float32 on demand."""
    def __init__(self, raw):
        self.raw = raw

    def __getitem__(self, e):
        return (np.asarray(self.raw[e]).astype(np.uint32) << 16).view(np.float32)


def load_bf16(path: Path, shape: list[int]) -> np.ndarray:
    raw = np.fromfile(path, dtype="<u2")
    if raw.size != int(np.prod(shape)):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: {raw.size} values, expected shape {shape}")
    return (raw.astype(np.uint32) << 16).view(np.float32).reshape(shape)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ quantizers
def q2_0(w: np.ndarray, importance: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    """[..., n] float32 -> bytes of Q2_0 blocks (fp16 d, 16 bytes of 2-bit codes, code = q + 1, 4 per byte)."""
    x = w.reshape(-1, 64).astype(np.float32)
    weights = 1.0
    if importance is not None:
        importance = np.asarray(importance, dtype=np.float32)
        if importance.shape != (w.shape[-1],) or not np.isfinite(importance).all() or (importance < 0).any():
            raise ValueError("Q2 importance must be finite nonnegative input-channel weights")
        if not np.isfinite(x).all():
            raise ValueError("Q2 calibration requires finite weights")
        weights = np.broadcast_to(importance, w.shape).reshape(-1, 64)
    amax = np.abs(x).max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    best_err = np.full((x.shape[0], 1), np.inf, dtype=np.float32)
    best_d = np.zeros_like(amax)
    if importance is not None:

        best_d = seed[:, :2].copy().view(np.float16).astype(np.float32)
        reconstructed = dequant("q2_0", seed, x.size).reshape(x.shape)
        best_err = (((reconstructed - x) ** 2) * weights).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    # Candidate scales span amax/2 (the +2 level reaches the max) to amax (the ggml reference); 17 steps.
    factors = np.linspace(0.5, 1.0, 17, dtype=np.float32)
    if importance is not None:
        factors = np.concatenate((factors, -factors))
    for f in factors:
        d = amax * f
        if importance is not None:
            d = d.astype(np.float16).astype(np.float32)
        inv = np.where(d != 0, 1.0 / np.where(d != 0, d, 1.0), 0.0)
        q = np.clip(np.rint(x * inv), -1, 2)
        err = (((q * d - x) ** 2) * weights).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        better = err < best_err
        best_err = np.where(better, err, best_err)
        best_d = np.where(better, d, best_d)
    # ponytail: diagonal activation moments and four local fits; full Hessians need a separate measured case.
    for _ in range(4 if importance is not None else 0):
        inv = np.where(best_d != 0, 1.0 / np.where(best_d != 0, best_d, 1.0), 0.0)
        q = np.clip(np.rint(x * inv), -1, 2)
        qq = (weights * q * q).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        d = ((weights * x * q).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) / np.where(qq != 0, qq, 1.0))
        d = d.astype(np.float16).astype(np.float32)
        inv = np.where(d != 0, 1.0 / np.where(d != 0, d, 1.0), 0.0)
        q = np.clip(np.rint(x * inv), -1, 2)
        err = (((q * d - x) ** 2) * weights).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        better = err < best_err
        best_err = np.where(better, err, best_err)
        best_d = np.where(better, d, best_d)
    d16 = best_d.astype(np.float16)
    d = d16.astype(np.float32)                                   # quantize against the STORED scale
    inv = np.where(d != 0, 1.0 / np.where(d != 0, d, 1.0), 0.0)
    codes = (np.clip(np.rint(x * inv), -1, 2) + 1).astype(np.uint8)          # 0..3
    c = codes.reshape(-1, 16, 4)
    packed = (c[:, :, 0] | (c[:, :, 1] << 2) | (c[:, :, 2] << 4) | (c[:, :, 3] << 6)).astype(np.uint8)
    out = np.empty((x.shape[0], 18), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :2] = d16.view(np.uint8).reshape(-1, 2)
    out[:, 2:] = packed
    return out.reshape(-1)


def q4_0(w: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """ggml quantize_row_q4_0_ref: d = max / -8 (signed max), code = clamp(round(x/d + 8.5) truncated, 0, 15)."""
    x = w.reshape(-1, 32).astype(np.float32)
    idx = np.abs(x).argmax(axis=1)
    mx = x[np.arange(x.shape[0]), idx][:, None]
    d = mx / -8.0
    inv = np.where(d != 0, 1.0 / np.where(d != 0, d, 1.0), 0.0)
    q = np.minimum(15, np.trunc(x * inv + 8.5)).astype(np.uint8)
    packed = (q[:, :16] | (q[:, 16:] << 4)).astype(np.uint8)
    out = np.empty((x.shape[0], 18), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :2] = d.astype(np.float16).view(np.uint8).reshape(-1, 2)
    out[:, 2:] = packed
    return out.reshape(-1)


def q8_0(w: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    x = w.reshape(-1, 32).astype(np.float32)
    d = np.abs(x).max(axis=1, keepdims=True) / 127.0
    inv = np.where(d > 0, 1.0 / np.where(d > 0, d, 1.0), 0.0)
    q = np.rint(x * inv).astype(np.int8)
    out = np.empty((x.shape[0], 34), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :2] = d.astype(np.float16).view(np.uint8).reshape(-1, 2)
    out[:, 2:] = q.view(np.uint8)
    return out.reshape(-1)


def dequant(kind: str, blob: np.ndarray, n: int) -> np.ndarray:
    if kind == "q5_0":
        return gguf.dequantize(blob, gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q5_0).reshape(-1)[:n]
    if kind == "q2_0":
        b = blob.reshape(-1, 18)
        d = b[:, :2].copy().view(np.float16).astype(np.float32)
        qs = b[:, 2:]
        codes = np.stack([(qs >> s) & 3 for s in (0, 2, 4, 6)], axis=2).reshape(-1, 64).astype(np.float32)
        return ((codes - 1.0) * d).reshape(-1)[:n]
    if kind == "q4_0":
        b = blob.reshape(-1, 18)
        d = b[:, :2].copy().view(np.float16).astype(np.float32)
        qs = b[:, 2:]
        q = np.concatenate([qs & 15, qs >> 4], axis=1).astype(np.float32)
        return ((q - 8.0) * d).reshape(-1)[:n]
    b = blob.reshape(-1, 34)
    d = b[:, :2].copy().view(np.float16).astype(np.float32)
    return (b[:, 2:].view(np.int8).astype(np.float32) * d).reshape(-1)[:n]


QUANT = {"q2_0": (q2_0, gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q2_0, 64, 18),
         "q4_0": (q4_0, gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q4_0, 32, 18),
         "q5_0": (lambda x: gguf.quantize(x, gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q5_0).reshape(-1),
                  gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q5_0, 32, 22),
         "q8_0": (q8_0, gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q8_0, 32, 34)}


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--src", required=True, help="directory written by tools/mtp_fetch.py fetch")
    ap.add_argument("--experts", choices=sorted(QUANT), default="q2_0")
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--q2-imatrix", type=Path,
                    help="optional NPZ of per-expert input-channel second moments: gate_up_proj and down_proj")
    ap.add_argument("--check-experts", type=int, default=8, help="experts per tensor used for the error report")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.q2_imatrix and a.experts != "q2_0":
        ap.error("--q2-imatrix requires --experts q2_0")
    src = Path(a.src)
    manifest = json.loads((src / "mtp-manifest.json").read_text())
    moments = {}
    if a.q2_imatrix:
        with np.load(a.q2_imatrix, allow_pickle=False) as data:
            for t in manifest:
                if t["name"] in EXPERT_TENSORS:
                    key = t["name"].rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
                    values = np.asarray(data[key], dtype=np.float32)
                    if values.shape != (t["shape"][0], t["shape"][-1]) or not np.isfinite(values).all() or (values < 0).any():
                        raise ValueError(f"{key}: invalid calibration moments")
                    moments[key] = values
    fn, qtype, block, block_bytes = QUANT[a.experts]
    w = gguf.GGUFWriter(a.out, "qwen4exp-mtp")
    w.add_string("strata.mtp.source", "Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next BF16 checkpoint, mtp.* tensors")
    w.add_string("strata.mtp.source_sha256", hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps({t["name"]: t["sha256"] for t in manifest}, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest())
    w.add_string("strata.mtp.expert_format", a.experts)
    w.add_string("strata.mtp.expert_quantizer", "activation-weighted signed scale search" if a.q2_imatrix else
                 "per-block MSE scale search" if a.experts == "q2_0" else "ggml reference")
    if a.q2_imatrix:
        w.add_string("strata.mtp.imatrix_sha256", hashlib.sha256(a.q2_imatrix.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    report = []
    for t in sorted(manifest, key=lambda t: t["name"]):
        name, shape = t["name"], t["shape"]
        t0 = time.time()
        if name in EXPERT_TENSORS:
            # Streamed one expert at a time from a read-only view: the fused gate_up tensor alone is 6.7 GB as
            # float32, so it is never materialized whole.
            raw = np.memmap(src / t["file"], dtype="<u2", mode="r", shape=tuple(shape))
            x = _Experts(raw)
            if shape[-1] % block:
                raise ValueError(f"{name}: inner dim {shape[-1]} not a multiple of {block}")
            importance = moments.get(name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1])
            parts = [q2_0(x[e], importance[e]) if importance is not None else fn(x[e])
                     for e in range(shape[0])]                    # one expert at a time bounds memory
            blob = np.concatenate(parts)
            errs = []
            for e in range(min(a.check_experts, shape[0])):
                ref = x[e].reshape(-1)
                got = dequant(a.experts, parts[e], ref.size)
                errs.append(float(np.sqrt(((got - ref) ** 2).mean()) / (np.sqrt((ref ** 2).mean()) + 1e-12)))
            # gguf-py takes the quantized bytes with the ELEMENT shape; ggml order is innermost-first.
            w.add_tensor(name, blob, raw_shape=list(shape[:-1]) + [shape[-1] // block * block_bytes], raw_dtype=qtype)
            report.append({"tensor": name, "format": a.experts, "bytes": int(blob.size),
                           "relative_rms_error_first_experts": round(float(np.mean(errs)), 5),
                           "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)})
        elif len(shape) == 1:
            x = load_bf16(src / t["file"], shape)
            w.add_tensor(name, x.astype(np.float32))
            report.append({"tensor": name, "format": "F32", "bytes": x.size * 4})
        else:
            bf = np.fromfile(src / t["file"], dtype="<u2").reshape(shape)
            w.add_tensor(name, bf, raw_dtype=gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.BF16)
            report.append({"tensor": name, "format": "BF16", "bytes": bf.size * 2})
        print(f"{name}: {report[-1]['format']} {report[-1]['bytes'] / 1e6:.1f} MB", flush=True)
    w.write_header_to_file()
    w.write_kv_data_to_file()
    w.write_tensors_to_file()
    w.close()
    total = sum(r["bytes"] for r in report)
    Path(a.out + ".report.json").write_text(json.dumps({"total_bytes": total, "tensors": report}, indent=1))
    print(f"wrote {a.out}: {total / 1e9:.3f} GB of tensor data")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import copy

from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(p.R))
from serve import server as s


def quality(name):
    out = p.H / name
    out.mkdir()
    baseline = json.loads((p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))

    runtime = p.H / 'activation-calibration-r2/rt-q2-calibrated'
    calibrated['args'][calibrated['args'].index('--mtp') + 1] = str(runtime)
    combined = copy.deepcopy(calibrated)
    combined['env']['STRATA_MTP_CUM_MIN_P'] = '0.5'
    cfgs = dict(baseline=baseline, early=early, calibrated=calibrated, combined=combined)
    inputs = json.loads((p.H / 'gated-current-r1-inputs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    archive = json.loads((p.H / 'gated-current-r1/results.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    reference = {row['case']: row for row in archive['runs'][0]['rows']}
    r = dict(complete=False, scope=__doc__, configs=cfgs, inputs=inputs, runs=[])
    save = lambda: p.b.save(out / 'results.json', r)
    (out / 'runner.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    save()
    with p.b.gpu_lock():
        try:
            files = [Path(__file__), Path(s.__file__), p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json',
                     p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs-mtp-early.json', Path(baseline['exe']),
                     runtime / 'experts.bin', p.R / 'data/expert-profile.bin']
            r['input_sha256'] = {str(f): p.b.sha(f) for f in files}
            manifest = json.loads((runtime.parent / 'weights.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            assert manifest['complete'] and p.b.sha(runtime / 'experts.bin') == manifest['sha256']
            for mode, cfg in cfgs.items():
                arm = dict(mode=mode, rows=[])
                r['runs'].append(arm)
                engine = s.StrataEngine.__new__(s.StrataEngine)
                try:
                    args, env = s.engine_args(cfg), s.child_env(cfg)
                    assert args == cfg['args']
                    assert all(env[k] == v for k, v in cfg['env'].items())
                    log = out / (mode + '.stderr')
                    engine.__init__(cfg['exe'], args, cwd=cfg.get('cwd'), log=str(log), env=env)
                    arm['info'] = engine.info
                    assert engine.info['expert_slots'] == 5771 and engine.info['lookup'] == 0
                    warm = [t for t in engine.generate(inputs['Chinese'], 16, {'temperature': 0}, threading.Event()) if t is not None]
                    arm['initializer'] = dict(tokens=warm, **engine.last)
                    for case, ids in inputs.items():
                        tokens = [t for t in engine.generate(ids, 128, {'temperature': 0}, threading.Event()) if t is not None]
                        row = dict(case=case, tokens=tokens, **engine.last)
                        row['matches'] = tokens == reference[case]['tokens']
                        assert row['matches'] and row['generated'] == len(tokens) == reference[case]['generated']
                        assert row['prompt_tokens'] == len(ids) and row['finish'] == reference[case]['finish']
                        assert row['reused'] == 0
                        arm['rows'].append(row)
                        save()
                        print('QUALITY', mode, case, 'MATCH', row['drafts_accepted'], '/', row['drafts_offered'], flush=True)
                finally:
                    if hasattr(engine, 'proc') and engine.proc is not None:
                        proc = engine.proc
                        engine.close()
                        arm['exit_code'] = proc.returncode
                    save()
                assert arm['exit_code'] == 0
                arm['stderr'] = log.read_text(encoding='utf8')
                if mode in ('early', 'combined'):
                    assert 'MTP cumulative confidence floor 0.5 (draft and verify windows)' in arm['stderr']
                arm['accepted'] = sum(row['drafts_accepted'] for row in arm['rows'])
                arm['offered'] = sum(row['drafts_offered'] for row in arm['rows'])
                arm['rate'] = arm['accepted'] / arm['offered']

            baseline_rows, early_rows = [run['rows'] for run in r['runs'][:2]]

            assert all(p.b.sha(Path(f)) == h for f, h in r['input_sha256'].items())

    print('PASS published calibration, both performance trials and four server adapter checks')


def trials():
    import cumulative
    import weighted
    with p.b.gpu_lock():
        # ponytail: one serialized history keeps another deployment from changing the baseline between trials.
        lock = p.b.gpu_lock
        p.b.gpu_lock = nullcontext
        try:
            manifest = json.loads((p.H / 'activation-calibration-r2/weights.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            assert manifest['complete']
            cfg = json.loads((p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))

                tokens = [t for t in engine.generate(inputs[case], 128, {'temperature': 0}, threading.Event()) if t is not None]
                row = dict(case=case, tokens=tokens, **engine.last)
                expected = next(row for row in reference['rows'] if row['case'] == case)
                assert all(row[k] == expected[k] for k in ('tokens', 'generated', 'prompt_tokens', 'finish',
                                                          'reused', 'drafts_accepted', 'drafts_offered'))
                r['rows'].append(row)
                save()
                print('OPTIONAL', case, 'MATCH', row['drafts_accepted'], '/', row['drafts_offered'], flush=True)
            proc = engine.proc
            engine.close()
            r['exit_code'] = proc.returncode
            assert r['exit_code'] == 0
            assert all(p.b.sha(Path(f)) == h for f, h in r['input_sha256'].items())
            assert p.b.sha(profile) == r['config_sha256']
            assert all(p.b.sha(runtime / name) == digest for name, digest in r['runtime_sha256'].items())
            r['stderr'] = (out / 'engine.stderr').read_text(encoding='utf8')
            if mode == 'combined':
                assert 'MTP cumulative confidence floor 0.5 (draft and verify windows)' in r['stderr']
                backup = p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs-before-mtp-combined-20261105.json'
                with backup.open('xb') as file:
                    file.write(primary.read_bytes())
                assert p.b.sha(backup) == r['input_sha256'][str(primary)]
                pending = primary.with_suffix('.mtp-combined-pending.json')
                with pending.open('xb') as file:
                    file.write(profile.read_bytes())
                assert p.b.sha(primary) == p.b.sha(backup)
                pending.replace(primary)
                assert p.b.sha(primary) == r['config_sha256']
                r.update(default_replaced=True, backup=str(backup),
                         adoption_reason='User selected the combination despite the measured gate not passing.',
                         primary_sha256=p.b.sha(primary))
            r['complete'] = True
            save()
            archive['optional_' + mode + '_profile'] = dict(r, runner=(out / 'runner.py').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            p.b.save(archive_path, archive)
            print('PASS', mode, 'stable runtime, complete outputs; default replaced:', r['default_replaced'], flush=True)
        except BaseException:
            r['error'] = traceback.format_exc()
            raise
        finally:
            if hasattr(engine, 'proc') and engine.proc is not None:
                engine.close()
            save()


def trials():
    import cumulative
    import weighted
    with p.b.gpu_lock():
        # ponytail: one serialized history keeps another deployment from changing the baseline between trials.
        lock = p.b.gpu_lock
        p.b.gpu_lock = nullcontext
        try:
            manifest = json.loads((p.H / 'activation-calibration-r2/weights.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            assert manifest['complete']
            cfg = json.loads((p.R / 'strata-iq2_xs.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            old = json.loads((p.H / 'cumulative-current-r1/results.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
            if cfg != old['configs']['baseline'] or p.b.sha(Path(cfg['exe'])) != old['input_sha256'][str(Path(cfg['exe']))]:
                cumulative.run('cumulative-hc-sg16-r1')
                refresh_early()
            weighted.run('weighted-current-r1')
            weighted.run('combined-current-r1', early=True)
            quality('quality-current-r1')
            publish()
